== Description ==

The completed red and common Grandezza player-card sets for the [[2024 World Championship]] in Bochum, photographed in cloth bags. The top card of each stack depicts [[AJ Hatoum]].

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2024-worlds-bochum, Thomas Santosuosso (LargePorg), 22 September 2024 (12:29 CEST). Original file name: 1000011865.jpg (4000×2252); Slack file id F07NA9T8X5L.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Thomas Santosuosso]] (Slack: LargePorg)
* '''Date:''' 22 September 2024 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' No people in the photograph; [[AJ Hatoum]] is depicted on the top cards of both stacks.
